title: AUTO FLIGHT - GENERAL
question: What are the main components that make up the two-axis configurations of the GFC-700 and KAP-140 autopilot systems as outlined in the chapter?
answer: The GFC-700 flight control system is a two-axis  autopilot system. The GFC-700 flight control system has the GIA-63W Integrated Avionics Unit, Primary Flight Display , Multi-Function Display , roll axis servo, pitch axis servo, pitch trim servo, and servo mounts.The KAP-1 40 flight control system can be one of two autopilot systems: single-axis  or two-axis (1) The KAP-140 single-axis configuration has the flight computer, configuration module, roll axis servo actuator, rate gyro, directional gyro and servo mount. (2)  The KAP-1 40 two-axis configuration has the flight computer, configuration module, roll axis servo actuator, pitch axis servo actuator, pitch trim servo actuator, rate gyro, directional gyro and servo mounts.This chapter gives the removal and installation procedures for the KAP-1 40  and GFC-700 autopilot flight computers and servo actuators.
